title: Events forwarded through SubViewport.push_input are not seen by Area2Ds
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439], v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee], v4.2.stable.official [46dc27791], v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 13 Dec 2025 18:23:21 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 154.8 GiB memory

### Issue description

Events forwarded through SubViewport.push_input are not seen by Area2Ds.

They are seen by buttons and other controls.

The same Area2Ds receive events as expected when they are inside the main viewport.

This isn't a problem with not calling notify_mouse_entered/notify_mouse_exited.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the demo project.
2. Click the button and mouse over with the Area2D which is in the main viewport. Both print messages to the output.
3. Do it again with the button and Area2D which is in the subviewport and rendered on the mesh. The button responds to mouse input and prints a message when clicked. The Area2D is silent.

My expected, and desired, behaviour is that the Area2D in a subviewport responds to pushed events just as the button does.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[push_input_2026-01-27_02-52-40.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24872468/push_input_2026-01-27_02-52-40.zip)
